metadata.question: Was nightime brightness around the Aswan High Dam higher than the Grand Ethopian Renaissance Dam in 2016?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use VIIRS nighttime lights data (NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG) - Time period: 2016 (full year) - Locations: Two points - Aswan High Dam (Egypt) and Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam (Ethiopia) 2. Masking strategy: - Nighttime lights data doesn't need cloud masking - Use the 'avg_rad' band (average radiance) - Filter out poor quality data if needed 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: Both dams have valid radiance values (including 0 if truly dark) - C1: No images in collection for 2016 - C2: No valid pixels after processing (unlikely for nighttime lights) - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN - A: Aswan > Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam - B: Aswan <= Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Data Acquisition & Check # VIIRS Nighttime Lights - Monthly composites col = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG') \ .filterDate('2016-01-01', '2016-12-31') \ .select('avg_rad') print(f"Total images in 2016: {col.size().getInfo()}") if col.size().getInfo() == 0: print("No nighttime lights data for 2016.") print("C1") else: # 3. Processing - Calculate mean annual nighttime brightness mean_img = col.mean() # 4. Calculate brightness for both locations aswan_stats = mean_img.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=aswan_area, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ) gerd_stats = mean_img.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=gerd_area, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ) aswan_brightness = aswan_stats.get('avg_rad').getInfo() gerd_brightness = gerd_stats.get('avg_rad').getInfo() # Check pixel counts to ensure valid data count_aswan = mean_img.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=aswan_area, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('avg_rad').getInfo() count_gerd = mean_img.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=gerd_area, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('avg_rad').getInfo() print(f"Aswan High Dam - Brightness: {aswan_brightness:.4f}, Pixels: {int(count_aswan)}") print(f"Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam - Brightness: {gerd_brightness:.4f}, Pixels: {int(count_gerd)}") # 5. Validation & Final Answer if count_aswan == 0 or count_gerd == 0: print("No valid pixels in one or both areas.") print("C2") elif aswan_brightness is None or gerd_brightness is None: print("Calculation failed - returned None.") print("C3") elif aswan_brightness > gerd_brightness: print(f"Aswan ({aswan_brightness:.4f}) > GERD ({gerd_brightness:.4f})") print("A") else: print(f"Aswan ({aswan_brightness:.4f}) <= GERD ({gerd_brightness:.4f})") print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
# Aswan High Dam, Egypt (24.088N, 32.877E)
aswan_point = ee.Geometry.Point([32.877, 24.088])

# Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam, Ethiopia (11.215N, 35.093E)
gerd_point = ee.Geometry.Point([35.093, 11.215])

# Create buffer areas around each dam (2km radius for better sampling)
aswan_area = aswan_point.buffer(2000)
gerd_area = gerd_point.buffer(2000)

# 2. Data Acquisition & Check
# VIIRS Nighttime Lights - Monthly composites
col = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG') \
    .filterDate('2016-01-01', '2016-12-31') \
    .select('avg_rad')

print(f"Total images in 2016: {col.size().getInfo()}")

if col.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No nighttime lights data for 2016.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Processing - Calculate mean annual nighttime brightness
    mean_img = col.mean()
    
    # 4. Calculate brightness for both locations
    aswan_stats = mean_img.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=aswan_area,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    )
    
    gerd_stats = mean_img.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=gerd_area,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    )
    
    aswan_brightness = aswan_stats.get('avg_rad').getInfo()
    gerd_brightness = gerd_stats.get('avg_rad').getInfo()
    
    # Check pixel counts to ensure valid data
    count_aswan = mean_img.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=aswan_area,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('avg_rad').getInfo()
    
    count_gerd = mean_img.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=gerd_area,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('avg_rad').getInfo()
    
    print(f"Aswan High Dam - Brightness: {aswan_brightness:.4f}, Pixels: {int(count_aswan)}")
    print(f"Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam - Brightness: {gerd_brightness:.4f}, Pixels: {int(count_gerd)}")
    
    # 5. Validation & Final Answer
    if count_aswan == 0 or count_gerd == 0:
        print("No valid pixels in one or both areas.")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    elif aswan_brightness is None or gerd_brightness is None:
        print("Calculation failed - returned None.")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    elif aswan_brightness > gerd_brightness:
        print(f"Aswan ({aswan_brightness:.4f}) > GERD ({gerd_brightness:.4f})")
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print(f"Aswan ({aswan_brightness:.4f}) <= GERD ({gerd_brightness:.4f})")
        print("<answer>B</answer>")
